attempts.summary: Configured a VRRP-based shared address (keepalived, VIP 10.100.53.200/24 on br-lan) across node1 (priority 150, MASTER) and node2 (priority 100, BACKUP) on the OpenWrt private network shared with node3. Verified node3 (CentOS Stream 10) reaches the VIP continuously, demonstrated automatic failover when node1's keepalived was stopped (VIP moved to node2 with only one transient delayed reply out of 88 pings, no full packet loss), and automatic preemption back to node1 on restore. Completed the mandatory node-restart evidence protocol on all three nodes sequentially (node2, then node1, then node3), each showing a changed OS boot_id, keepalived auto-recovering and re-electing correctly, and node3 regaining VIP reachability after every reboot.
